designs.label: 3-hex Timber sawmill factory
designs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE canonical top-down transparent game building sprite, production art for a Godot hex-grid tactics game.
Input image 1 is a STYLE reference only: match its detailed hand-painted roof tiles/planks, crisp dark eaves, restrained rustic texture and orthographic overhead camera. Input image 2 is a STRICT FOOTPRINT AND PROPORTION GUIDE, not scenery: its grey shape is the desired connected building plan; the green hex outlines indicate the three allowed cells. Design the entire roof, walls, eaves, chimney and all appendages inside that plan and comfortably inside the three outlined hexes. Do not reproduce the hexes, outlines, grey fill, green fill or guide background in the output.
Primary request: one continuous very long narrow timber sawmill factory. Three connected industrial timber shed bays along a vertical axis, weathered brown plank roofing, substantial timber ridge beams and little roof vents. Each bay joins directly into the next under continuous walls. All machinery and loading doors are under the existing roof line. No detached equipment, log piles, rail track, yard or exterior platforms.
Material: natural medium BROWN wooden plank or shingle roofing, brown timber walls. All roofs brown, never red or grey.
Composition: EXACTLY ONE complete isolated building centered on a truly transparent background, not a sheet or multiple views. Main long axis VERTICAL. Very slender elongated proportions: approximately 1 unit wide by 6 units long, matching the narrow grey rectangle in the guide. Preserve this narrowness; the three hexes are in a straight vertical line.
Strict orthographic camera directly above the roof, zero perspective, only narrow eave/wall edges. Include all wall details and projected features within the silhouette. Clean alpha zero around the complete building; no ambient halo, soft external shadow or ground shadow. Generous transparent image margins. Painted texture rather than photographic rendering. No text, labels, grids, hex borders, terrain, trees, ground, floor, paving, figures, cars, smoke or detached objects. Do not add an entrance porch outside the guide. The entire sprite must fit inside exactly three cells; this is the primary constraint.
